description: The mathematics of money and risk: interest and the time value of money, annuities and loans, bonds and yields, risk and return, portfolio theory, options and derivatives, and the mathematics of microfinance and credit scoring. Every formula is derived and then computed, plotted and simulated in the browser on real cases such as treasury bills, mobile loans and susu groups.
modelledOn: Hull, Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives
outcomes: Compute present and future values under simple, compound and continuous interest and compare nominal, effective and real rates.
Value annuities and perpetuities and build amortisation schedules for loans, mortgages and microloans.
Price bonds and treasury bills, compute their yields, duration and convexity and interpret the yield curve.
Measure risk and return, construct efficient portfolios and apply the capital asset pricing model.
Price forwards and options with no-arbitrage, binomial and Black-Scholes models and explain their use for hedging.
Build and evaluate a credit scoring model and analyse the true cost of microfinance and mobile loans.

units.title: Interest and the time value of money
topics: Simple and compound interest; accumulation and discount functions
Nominal and effective rates, compounding frequency, continuous compounding and the force of interest
Present and future value; equations of value and solving for unknown rates and times
Inflation and real interest rates; the Fisher equation; the Bank of Ghana policy rate and its effect on lending rates
Comparing savings options: bank deposits, mobile money interest and a susu collector's fee as an implied rate

units.title: Annuities and cash-flow valuation
topics: Annuities immediate and due; perpetuities; deferred annuities
Annuities with varying payments: arithmetic and geometric growth
Net present value, internal rate of return and payback period; choosing between projects
Building cash-flow models in a spreadsheet and in code

units.title: Loans and amortisation
topics: Amortisation schedules: interest and principal in each instalment; outstanding balance (prospective and retrospective)
Sinking funds; flat-rate versus reducing-balance interest and why flat rates mislead
Annual percentage rate, fees and the true cost of credit; consumer credit disclosure
Mortgages, car loans, hire purchase and refinancing decisions
Pricing a mobile nano-loan with a fee and a short tenor, and converting it to an annual rate

units.title: Bonds and yields
topics: Bond terminology: face value, coupon, maturity, clean and dirty price, accrued interest
Bond pricing and yield to maturity; premium, par and discount bonds
Treasury bills: discount and interest yields, the 91-day and 182-day bill auctions in Ghana
Term structure: spot rates, forward rates, bootstrapping the yield curve, theories of the term structure
Duration, modified duration and convexity; immunisation of a liability
Credit risk, default and sovereign debt restructuring, with Ghana's domestic debt exchange as a case

units.title: Risk and return
topics: Holding-period returns, arithmetic and geometric means, annualising returns
Random returns: expected value, variance, standard deviation, covariance and correlation
Risk preferences and utility functions; risk aversion and certainty equivalents
Value at risk and the limits of the normal distribution: fat tails and skew
Returns on the Ghana Stock Exchange and other African markets analysed from price data

units.title: Portfolio theory
topics: Two-asset and multi-asset portfolios; diversification and the effect of correlation
Mean-variance optimisation; the efficient frontier and the minimum-variance portfolio
The risk-free asset, the capital market line and the tangency portfolio; the Sharpe ratio
The capital asset pricing model: beta, the security market line, systematic and idiosyncratic risk
Factor models and arbitrage pricing theory in outline; market efficiency
Computing an efficient frontier numerically in the browser

units.title: Options and derivatives basics
topics: Forwards and futures: payoffs, no-arbitrage pricing, cost of carry; currency forwards for the cedi
Options: calls and puts, payoffs and profit diagrams, put-call parity and option strategies
The binomial model: replicating portfolios, risk-neutral valuation, multi-period trees, American options
Brownian motion in outline and the Black-Scholes formula; the Greeks and delta hedging
Monte Carlo pricing of options and convergence of the binomial tree to Black-Scholes
Uses of derivatives in Africa: commodity hedging for cocoa and gold, and the risks of speculation

units.title: Microfinance
topics: Microfinance models: group lending, joint liability, village banking and rotating savings (susu and ROSCAs)
Analysing a susu group or ROSCA as a sequence of loans and savings; the implied interest rate for each position
Microfinance interest rates: operating costs, loan size, portfolio at risk and sustainability
Mobile credit and digital lending: nano-loans on mobile money, over-indebtedness and consumer protection

units.title: Credit scoring
topics: Credit risk measures: probability of default, loss given default, exposure at default and expected loss
Scorecards: logistic regression, weight of evidence, information value and points scaling
Model evaluation: ROC curves, the Gini coefficient, the KS statistic, calibration and cut-off choice
Alternative data for thin-file borrowers: mobile money histories, airtime top-ups and credit bureau data, and fairness concerns
Capstone: build and evaluate a credit scoring model for a microfinance lender on a synthetic loan book

schedule.title: Interest, discounting and equations of value
schedule.exercise: Problem set: find accumulated value under simple, compound and continuous interest for the same principal, and solve an equation of value for an unknown rate.

tasks.title: Compute the value of GHS 5000 after 3 years at 18 percent under simple and annual compound interest, and plot both growth curves
Convert between nominal rates with monthly, quarterly and continuous compounding and the effective annual rate, and tabulate the six results
Solve for the unknown interest rate in an equation of value with three payments using a root-finding routine, and check it by reaccumulating the cash flows

schedule.title: Inflation, real rates and saving options
schedule.exercise: Compare three ways to save GHS 200 a month (bank deposit, mobile money interest, susu collector) by effective annual rate and real return after inflation.

tasks.title: Apply the Fisher equation to nominal rates and inflation figures for five years and compute the real interest rate for each
Convert a susu collector's monthly fee into an implied annual interest rate for three contribution sizes and compare it with a bank deposit
Simulate the real value of a one-year GHS 10000 deposit under three inflation paths, and rank savings options by real return

schedule.title: Annuities, NPV and IRR
schedule.exercise: Evaluate two investment projects by NPV, IRR and payback, explain why they can disagree, and say which you would choose for a small solar-pump business.

tasks.title: Compute the present value of a 5-year annuity-immediate and annuity-due of GHS 1000 at 12 percent and compare them
Compute NPV, IRR and payback for a solar-pump project with a given cash-flow table and decide whether to invest
Build a cash-flow model with a growing payment stream in code or a spreadsheet, and run a sensitivity analysis on the discount rate from 8 to 24 percent

schedule.title: Loans, amortisation and the true cost of credit
schedule.exercise: Write a customer-friendly comparison of a flat-rate loan and a reducing-balance loan with the same stated rate, showing the APR of each.

tasks.title: Build the amortisation schedule of a GHS 12000 loan over 12 months, listing interest, principal and outstanding balance each month
Convert a flat rate of 2 percent per month into the equivalent reducing-balance APR and show the schedule for both
Price a mobile nano-loan with a 5 percent fee over 14 days, convert it to an annual rate, and test the price against a cap of 120 percent

schedule.title: Bonds, bills and Treasury auctions
schedule.exercise: Price a 5-year coupon bond at three yields, find its yield from a quoted price, and compute the discount and interest yields of a 91-day bill.

tasks.title: Price a 3-year 10 percent coupon bond at yields of 8, 10 and 12 percent and classify each as premium, par or discount
Convert a 91-day treasury bill bid into discount rate, interest yield and annualised yield, and compare it with a 182-day bill
Compute the yield to maturity of a bond from its market price by root finding, and plot price against yield to show the convex relation

schedule.title: Yield curves, duration and credit risk
schedule.exercise: Bootstrap spot rates from three coupon bonds, compute duration and convexity of a liability, and explain how to immunise it.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the 1-, 2- and 3-year spot rates from given bond prices and plot the yield curve
Compute Macaulay duration, modified duration and convexity of a 5-year bond and estimate its price change for a 1 percent yield rise
Advise a pension fund in a branching case on holdings affected by a sovereign debt exchange, using evidence on yields, exposure and creditor losses

schedule.title: Returns, risk and market data
schedule.exercise: Compute daily and annualised returns and volatility for two Ghana Stock Exchange stocks from price data, and discuss why the normal model may understate losses.

tasks.title: Compute holding-period and annualised geometric returns for a stock from a table of monthly prices
Compute mean, variance and correlation of two stocks' returns from a price series and tabulate the covariance matrix
Estimate 95 percent value at risk for a stock by the normal model and by historical simulation, and compare them on a fat-tailed sample

schedule.title: Portfolio theory and the efficient frontier
schedule.exercise: Show on paper that a two-asset portfolio's risk falls as correlation falls, and find the minimum-variance weights for given volatilities and correlation.

tasks.title: Plot the risk of a two-asset portfolio against the weight of the first asset for correlations of 1, 0 and -0.5
Find the minimum-variance portfolio and the efficient frontier for three assets from given means and covariances
Add a risk-free asset, locate the tangency portfolio and the capital market line, and compute the Sharpe ratio of three candidate portfolios

schedule.title: CAPM, factor models and numerical frontiers
schedule.exercise: Estimate beta of a stock by regression against a market index, and say what the intercept and residual risk mean for a diversified investor.

tasks.title: Regress a stock's returns on a market index to estimate beta, and plot the security market line with the stock marked
Fit a two-factor model to a set of stock returns and explain how much of the variance each factor and the residual contribute
Compute an efficient frontier numerically from 200 random portfolios and an optimiser for five African stocks, and compare the two results

schedule.title: Forwards, futures and option pricing
schedule.exercise: Problem set: price a cedi-dollar forward from interest rates, draw profit diagrams of a covered call and a straddle, and price a two-period option on a binomial tree.

tasks.title: Draw payoff and profit diagrams for a long call and a long put with given premiums and mark the break-even points
Price a six-month cedi-dollar forward from spot and interest rates, and find the arbitrage profit if the market quote is different
Build a three-period binomial tree for a European and an American put, and compare their values and exercise boundaries

schedule.title: Black-Scholes, Monte Carlo and commodity hedging
schedule.exercise: Compare binomial, Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo prices of one option, and explain how a cocoa exporter could hedge with futures.

tasks.title: Price a European call with the Black-Scholes formula and compute delta, gamma and vega for it
Price a European call by Monte Carlo with 100000 paths, and compare it with the Black-Scholes value including the standard error
Evaluate a cocoa exporter's hedge with futures across three price scenarios, and show when hedging lowers risk and when it adds exposure

schedule.title: Microfinance and digital lending
schedule.exercise: Analyse a 10-member susu group: compute each member's implied interest rate by payout position, and say who gains and who pays.

tasks.title: Model a 10-member rotating savings group of GHS 100 each and compute the implied interest rate for the first and last payout positions
Compute the break-even interest rate for a microfinance lender from operating cost, loan size and portfolio at risk
Review a mobile lender's pricing in a branching case on repeat nano-loan borrowers, judging over-indebtedness evidence against consumer protection rules

schedule.title: Credit scoring and capstone
schedule.exercise: Capstone report: describe a credit scoring model for a microfinance lender, its variables, validation metrics, fairness checks and recommended cut-off.

tasks.title: Compute expected loss from probability of default, loss given default and exposure for a portfolio of ten loans
Compute an ROC curve, the Gini coefficient and the KS statistic for a given set of scores and outcomes
Build a logistic-regression scorecard on a synthetic loan book, scale scores to points, choose a cut-off, and report fairness across groups
